en-US.description: Quickly find files across your Windows PC and NAS using a full-text search engine.
en-US.longDescription: With the growth of files and data in homes and workplaces, you need a modern solution to find files no matter where they’re stored. Qsirch PC Edition allows you to quickly find files across your Windows PC and NAS using a full-text search engine with keywords, tags and various filters.
en-US.name: Qsirch PC Edition

zh-CN.description: Qsirch PC Edition 是一款快速的全文搜索引擎，能让您根据文件名、内容和元数据来查找文件。
zh-CN.longDescription: 随着工作、家中的文件与数据日渐增多，您需要一个现代化的数据搜索方案快速找寻存储在各处的文件数据。强大的 Qsirch PC Edition 计算机版搜索工具让您通过关键词、卷标与多样筛选器，快速找到您 Windows 计算机与 NAS 中的文件。
